Flashstep.Description: Decision speed. Kunai placement, angle changes and an unfinished teleport seal.
Flashstep.Name: Minato
Flashstep.Routes: ↑ rising kick (seals the body: 2 follows it up)  ·  ↓ spinning leg sweep (plants a marked kunai)  ·  ←→ angle step  ·  air: push kick / axe kick / flash switch

Techniques.Hint: Two seals planted at once • a hit seals the body
Techniques.Name: Marked Kunai

Techniques.Hint: Stick picks the seal and the side • strike or 3 on arrival
Techniques.Name: Flying Thunder God

Techniques.Hint: Instant after a teleport • plunges when airborne • ends a clean string
Techniques.Name: Rasengan

Techniques.Hint: Create an angle • no guaranteed hit
Techniques.Name: Quickstep

Techniques.Hint: Displace with a cutting gust
Techniques.Name: Wind Cut

Flashstep.Title: THE FAST PRODIGY

GentleFist.Description: Byakugan and the Gentle Fist. Palms that close chakra points, a perfect rotation defence.
GentleFist.Name: Neji
GentleFist.Routes: ↑ palm heel under the chin  ·  ↓ low rotation sweep (closes two points)  ·  ←→ circular step onto a chakra point  ·  air: twin palms / descending palm / spinning palm

Techniques.Hint: Spinning dome • repels strikes and blades • counter after
Techniques.Name: Rotation

Techniques.Hint: Air-pressure palm • pushes into walls • ends a clean string
Techniques.Name: Vacuum Palm

Techniques.Hint: Point blank • seals the chakra points (no jutsu)
Techniques.Name: 64 Palms

GentleFist.Title: THE HYUGA GENIUS

Lion.Description: Pressure. Kicks, wire and fire. A launcher he follows into the air and a Chidori that ends everything — or him.
Lion.Name: Sasuke
Lion.Routes: ↑ rising kick into Shadow of the Dancing Leaf (heavy in the air: LION COMBO)  ·  ↓ low kick sweep  ·  ←→ vault over into a back kick  ·  air: drive / axe kick / switch

Techniques.Hint: On a wired opponent: Dragon Flame runs along the wire
Techniques.Name: Great Fireball

Techniques.Hint: Flames with two shuriken hidden inside
Techniques.Name: Phoenix Flower

Techniques.Hint: A wired shuriken binds • then 1 for Dragon Flame
Techniques.Name: Wire Trap

Techniques.Hint: Charge, then a lightning thrust • a miss leaves him open
Techniques.Name: Chidori

Lion.Title: THE ROOKIE OF THE YEAR

Mirage.Description: Sharingan already awakened. Reads, precise shuriken, deception and Katon fire.
Mirage.Name: Itachi
Mirage.Routes: ↑ rising palm (shuriken cover the climb)  ·  ↓ reaping sweep  ·  ←→ feint step (an afterimage stays)  ·  air: side kick / hammer drop / hook switch

Techniques.Hint: Read one frontal strike or Rasengan • counter
Techniques.Name: Sharingan Read

Techniques.Hint: Five blades, then two hidden ones aimed at the dodge
Techniques.Name: Shadow Shuriken

Techniques.Hint: 3s decoy • a swing at it opens a punish
Techniques.Name: Genjutsu: Mirage

Techniques.Hint: A miss leaves the lane burning
Techniques.Name: Great Fireball

Techniques.Hint: Five small flames fanned at the opponent • pressure
Techniques.Name: Phoenix Flower

Mirage.Title: THE SHARINGAN PRODIGY

Sand.Description: The sand fights for him: an automatic shield, long sand lashes and a coffin that binds. Slow, patient, crushing.
Sand.Name: Gaara

Techniques.Hint: A wave of sand binds, then crushes • substitution escapes
Techniques.Name: Sand Coffin

Techniques.Hint: Six hardened sand blades
Techniques.Name: Sand Shuriken

Techniques.Hint: A wall of sand throws close attackers away
Techniques.Name: Desert Wave

Sand.Title: THE SAND PRODIGY
